visual.description: Fixed navigation bar with logo left, centered nav links, and a dropdown CTA button pinned to the right.
Full-viewport hero split asymmetrically: text block with headline, body, and CTA occupies the left ~40%, a large planet image bleeds off the right edge occupying ~60%.
Full-bleed landscape photo with a right-aligned text block (headline, body, CTA) overlaid in the upper-right quadrant.
Full-bleed aerial photo with a left-aligned text block overlaid in the lower-left, transitioning into the next section.
Full-bleed rocket-landing photo with headline text right-aligned and anchored near vertical center-right.
Two stacked full-width image panels of equal height — astronaut close-up on top, Starlink satellite array on bottom — with no text overlay on the top panel.
Full-bleed Starlink satellite array photo with left-aligned headline, body copy, and CTA overlaid at vertical center-left.
Minimal footer with centered navigation links and copyright text pinned to the far right, on a dark background.
